text: The four consumed surfaces of the pack step are called on their owners' published bases as synchronous answers, one hop with a 2 s budget, a GET retried once with jitter and a breaker per downstream: the pack and defect-list answer of rwb-document on /api/recovery/document/v1, the notice and template-status answer of rwb-comms on /api/recovery/comms/v1, the case answer with the route fact and the task raise of rwb-case on /api/recovery/case/v1, and the approval raise of RWB-P7-E2013-CON on /api/recovery/decision/v1, with the reference data of LOV-LEGAL-TYPE and LOV-LEGAL-STATUS read on RWB-P3-E1043-CON; every operation name that no source gives stays marked with the placeholder and every answer is faked.
why: The legacy step called the pack, the notice, the case and the task in process against one recovery schema, and TSD S4 T5.2 names the owners and calls their Java interfaces published; the target replaces an in-process call with contract-first REST (DP-11, ADR-020) and no source names the four operations, their paths or their error mappings. The reference data is DP-07 and outside this key's pattern set, so its read has no row either.
